specs.description: Telemetry asset is loaded and parsed correctly
specs.given: a telemetry.json asset with a mapping for 'compression_ratio' to '🧠 Ratio'
specs.then: the mapping is available for rendering

specs.description: Malformed telemetry asset does not crash the binary
specs.given: a telemetry.json asset containing invalid JSON
specs.then: it falls back to an empty mapping and logs a warning

specs.description: Render full telemetry for compression ratio and tokens saved
specs.given: a telemetry map with compression_ratio: '8.5x' and tokens_saved: '120k'
a telemetry map with only tokens_saved: '10k'
a telemetry map with only unknown_metric: '100'

specs.description: Telemetry badges are appended to the status line
specs.given: a running execution loop with active telemetry
specs.then: the rendered telemetry badges are visible at the end of the line

specs.description: Empty telemetry does not add trailing whitespace to status line
specs.given: a running execution loop with no active telemetry
specs.then: the status line ends exactly at the last status badge without extra spaces
